_comment: F-18 (2026-08-14 review): the authority manifest for the git-ignored Reference/ cache.
Reference/ holds ~22 GB of source snapshots, SDKs and test corpora that drift silently from the
authoritative pins - comments in code have occasionally cited a stale snapshot as truth. This
manifest names every EXPECTED entry, what kind of thing it is, and which tracked pin (if any)
is authoritative for it; scripts/check-reference-drift.sh compares the on-disk snapshot
versions against those pins and reports STALE / NO-IDENTITY / UNKNOWN entries.
Rules: Directory.Packages.props and .github/native-manifest/ffmpeg.lock are the truth -
NEVER a Reference/ folder name. Prefer versioned snapshot directories over '-master'/'-main'
clones (a name like SDL3-CS-master carries no identity at all). An entry that is absent on
disk is fine (fetch on demand); an on-disk directory not listed here should be added or removed.

Avalonia-*.reason: UI framework internals while debugging binding/layout behavior

AvaloniaEdit-master.reason: editor control reference; NO IDENTITY - re-clone as a versioned snapshot when next needed

FFmpeg.AutoGen-main.reason: upstream generator reference; the AUTHORITATIVE fork is vendored at External/FFmpeg.AutoGen (see nuget.config)

jack2-*.reason: JACK client API reference for the miniaudio backend's graph-thread notes

libass.reason: subtitle renderer reference; the shipped build is pinned by URL+SHA-256 in build.yml (0.17.5)

miniaudio-*.reason: MALib hand-mirrors this exact ABI; pinned at 0.11.25 in build.yml and Native-Dependencies.md

NDI SDK for Android.reason: licensed NDI SDK - deliberately untracked (NDI license); required only for HaViz.Android packaging

NDI SDK for Linux.reason: licensed NDI SDK - deliberately untracked (NDI license)

MIDI_Controllers.reason: device profile notes/captures for S.Control device matching

MMDTest.reason: ~21 GB real MMD model/motion corpus; environment-gated tests only - never a CI dependency

portaudio-*.reason: PALib binding reference; shipped build pinned at v19.7.0 in build.yml

portmidi-*.reason: PMLib binding reference; shipped build pinned at v2.0.7 in build.yml (snapshot may track a newer tag - the build pin is the truth)

projectm-*.reason: authoritative build source when present - scripts/build-projectm.sh uses it, else downloads the SHA-256-pinned 4.1.6 archive

SDL3-CS-*.reason: binding internals for the present layer

TestSubs.reason: real-world subtitle corpus; environment-gated tests only (CI uses the committed TestAssets fixtures)

Vortice.Windows-*.reason: D3D11 interop reference; KNOWN far behind the pin - refresh or delete when next touched

Xaml.Behaviors-master.reason: behaviors reference; NO IDENTITY - re-clone as a versioned snapshot when next needed

YT_DLP.reason: yt-dlp behavior notes for the YouTube source
